name: Charm Monster
summary: Charms a creature of any type that fails a Wisdom saving throw.

stats.effect: One creature you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. It does so with {ref:glossary/advantage} if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failed save, the target has the {ref:condition/charmed} condition until the spell ends or until you or your allies damage it. The {ref:condition/charmed} creature is {ref:glossary/friendly} to you. When the spell ends, the target knows it was {ref:condition/charmed} by you.
stats.higherLevels: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4.
